sentences.en: We abandoned the project because of a lack of funds.
sentences.zh: 因为资金不足，我们放弃了这个项目。

sentences.en: An acute lack of funds is holding up the plan.
sentences.zh: 由于资金短缺，计划被搁置了。

sentences.en: The trouble with us is that we have no funds.
sentences.zh: 我们的麻烦在于没有资金。

senses.zh: 积存；为…提供资金；提供资金偿付（债款等）的本息
